cohort: The study included 27 women with early-onset preeclampsia, 28 women with late-onset preeclampsia, and 28 healthy pregnant women.
finding: Lower maternal serum catestatin levels are associated with fetal cardiovascular dysfunction, suggesting catestatin can be a critical biochemical marker in fetal cardiac function evaluation.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of diagnosis for preeclampsia groups or equivalent for healthy controls.
